• *Source/Speaker:* Morgan Stanley
• *Announcement:* Morgan Stanley names IT as a ‘Dark Horse’ in its India strategy, identifying data centers as a new investment theme and favoring domestic cyclicals due to India's strengthening earnings cycle and rising consumption base\.
• *Market Stance:* 🟢 BULLISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* MEDIUM \(70\% \- This is an official investment strategy and market outlook from a major international brokerage house, signaling a clear directional view\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* None
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* IT, Infrastructure \(data centers, energy, defence, semiconductors\), Metals/Auto, Paints, Chemicals \(fertilizers\), Pharma \(healthcare is underweight per MS, but overall consumption boost helps\), Textiles \(consumer discretionary\), OGCs \(underweight per MS\)
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Inflows \(The positive outlook on specific Indian sectors and the broader consumption narrative from a leading global firm is likely to attract foreign capital, especially given low foreign positioning\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Indian fund managers should consider overweighting IT and domestic cyclical stocks, particularly those poised to benefit from India's growing consumption base and infrastructure development related to data centers, energy, and defense\.
